description: Shared contract summary. TypeScript contracts in packages/schema/src/contracts.ts are the executable source for the current dependency-light web build. The full 12-mechanism id list is canonical in packages/taxonomy/taxonomy.json, not duplicated here.

intrinsicAlphaSlice.description: The bounded four-mechanism subset the Local Preview (Level 2) and future Instrument Alpha (Level 3) detectors are scoped to. Every id must also exist in packages/taxonomy/taxonomy.json.
